methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.

actual_scope: Can the production R439 omission atlas research/r439-omission-atlas-seed81/verify.py adopt the proved exact packed integer-lane omission replays from research/omission-lanes-seed92/ (#1433) so that the shipped atlas is faster while every certificate field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after surveying leave-alone production rewrites through #2412, pending scalar-fused-dyadic production, and the deferred thin ck-dyadic production tip. Remaining proved opt-in adapter #1433 still left production atlas on per-omission literal replay; Linux host probe measured ~1.77× for the opt-in packing.
bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy PR1017 omission-atlas audits increase review throughput for R439 tooling without changing kappa or check coverage.
stop_rule: Stop after wiring one production object with identical-receipt evidence, pin-drift demotions, and a descriptive before/after wall-time sample clearly above ~1.5×; do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_OMISSION_LANES_PRODUCTION via research/omission-lanes-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_OMISSION_LANES_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5; vendor baseline.py; demote live atlas pins in omission-lanes-seed92 and r439-three-omission-distance.
